desc: Ceiling-tile shell guardian: floating pale ceiling-tile armor plates around a small black void face with sharp angry eyes, gold bolts, dangling wire tail. Living Backrooms creature, cute chibi but cool, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no shadow. Yellow wallpaper, cardboard brown, lavender, gold palette.
